newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha dragged lower by softer crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha dragged lower by softer crude.

text.p: Weaker crude knocked naphtha levels lower on Friday.
"Crude is worrying people," said one trader.
Swaps were talked 50 cents to $1 off Thursday's levels although little was actually concluded.

Traders said there was some petchem demand although most buyers were looking to forward price or delay their purchases. Some interest has been expressed about moving material transatlantic, but high freight costs and difficulty in finding tonnage persist. A similar situation in the Med has also been hampering activity. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 8980
